# kasaterm **A cross-platform GPU terminal built from scratch in Rust.** The cell renderer, Korean IME, and PTY are implemented as their own crates without off-the-shelf libraries,
and on top of them is a **GUI that manages multiple Claude instances like students**. [Demo](#데모) · [Strengths](#강점--전부-자체-구현했다) · [crate](#재사용-가능한-crate) · [Crosses machines](#기계를-가로지른다) · [Install](#설치--실행) · [Shortcuts](#단축키) · [Structure](#구조) --- ## Demo --- ## What is this A self-built GUI terminal. It is a native Rust app that handles tmux with **GUI buttons, drag, and natural language** instead of prefix keys. The renderer, Korean IME, and PTY were all **built directly without relying on off-the-shelf terminal libraries.** It can be read along two axes: - **Below: the terminal engine.** The wgpu cell renderer, the 2-set (dubeolsik) Korean input IME, and the cross-platform PTY were each carved out as **independent crates**. They are designed so that anyone building a terminal can take just the parts. - **Above: AI orchestration.** On top of that engine, the work of the Claude running in each pane is visible in real time through the BA GUI (Arona mode). It is not about reading logs but about *watching the work.* - **Outside: crossing machines.** Panes are not tied to this computer. You can [move](#기계를-가로지른다) a running session to another machine, mirror its screen in the original window, and continue viewing the same pane from a phone browser. --- ## Strengths: everything implemented in-house Not off-the-shelf libraries glued together; the core parts of the terminal were built from the ground up. | | What | crate | |---|---|---| | **GPU cell rendering** | Glyphs are baked once into a swash atlas, and one instance per cell is drawn. Baskerville42/outage-data-ua.body:
# outage-data-ua

A public repository and tools for automatically collecting, parsing, visualizing (HTML), and automatically generating PNG images of scheduled and emergency power outage charts in Ukraine.

The project fetches data from the public web pages of providers and stores it as JSON "as is" in the `data/` directory. This data is then displayed in a fixed HTML template and converted into PNG images, which are saved in `images/<region>/gpv-x-x.png`.

---

## Data format
Each region is stored in a file `data/<region>.json`. Basic structure (abbreviated):

```json
{
  "regionId": "kyiv",
  "regionAffiliation": "city of Kyiv",
  "lastUpdated": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z",
  "fact": { "updateFact": "06.11.2025 09:09" },
  "preset": { "updateFact": "04.11.2025 18:00" },
  "lastUpdateStatus": { "status": "parsed", "ok": true, "code": 200, "message": null, "at": "2025-11-06T11:41:56.430Z", "attempt": 5 },
  "meta": { "schemaVersion": "1.0.0", "contentHash": "..." }
}
```

- `preset` — scheduled outages for the week for each group (weekly template). Stored "as is", without normalizing the structure.
- `fact` — actual and emergency outages for today and tomorrow for each group. Also…

Fu021/Clash-of-Rust.description: A cross-platform proxy client based on Rust, Slint, and mihomo, supporting Windows, macOS, Linux, and Android.
Fu021/Clash-of-Rust.body:
A native Rust proxy client based on mihomo. Supports **Windows (x64 / ARM64)**, **Debian/Ubuntu (amd64 / ARM64, Ubuntu supports only 22.04 and above)**, **macOS 14 and above (Intel / Apple Silicon)**, and **Android 8.0 and above (ARM64 / ARMv7 / x86_64)**. Version **0.6.1**; for release notes, see [Release Notes](https://github.com/Fu021/Clash-of-Rust/blob/HEAD/docs/releases/0.6.1.md).

## Features

- **Lightweight**: Native Rust + Slint UI, no WebView required; page data is loaded on demand.
- **Offline-ready**: Built-in mihomo core and Geo data; one-click Geo data update.
- **IP Detection**: 183 check items covering exit IP, GitHub, AI services, and streaming media regional access; one-click detection shows a category report, click a category or status to view details, supports filtering and retesting by category.
- **A÷ Detection**: Collects Claude region, DNS, WebRTC, and browser signals, scans recorded project configurations and displays them by category. Optional one-click protection locks the node and rule/global mode, and enables TUN, encrypted DNS, and abnormal connection blocking; after turning it off, the original settings are restored. See [Detection Notes](https://github.com/Fu021/Clash-of-Rust/blob/HEAD/docs/claude-region-detection.md) for details.
- **Convenient Use**: Tray quick node switching, with optional display of upload and download speeds; supports background auto-start on boot, single instance, and network diagnostics; remembers normal window size; the core can be retried directly if it fails to start.
- **Client Updates**: Checks only stable releases; supports download progress and cancellation; after verification, desktop versions install automatically and restart, while on Android the system confirms the installation; failures display the reason.

SGLang is an open-source inference framework for large language, vision-language, and diffusion models, optimized for agentic workloads, large-scale serving, and RL rollouts. ## Get Started

Pull the Docker image, which includes SGLang and its dependencies:

```bash
docker pull lmsysorg/sglang:latest
```

Alternatively, install SGLang in an activated Python environment with uv:

```bash
uv pip install --prerelease=allow sglang
```

Next, launch your model:

- [Quickstart](https://docs.sglang.io/docs/get-started/quickstart): Run your first model and send a request.
- [Cookbook](https://cookbook.sglang.io/): Choose your model and hardware to get a ready-to-run launch command.

## iOS App Maintenance

Free Apple ID signing typically expires after 7 days. When the app won't open after expiration, reconnect the iPhone and press `Cmd + R` in Xcode to reinstall and renew the signing for 7 more days:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview
source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22
npx cap open ios
```

If you're only renewing the signing without changing content, you don't need to rebuild the web artifacts.

If you've modified the blog content, you need to rebuild and sync first:

```bash
cd /Users/max/Desktop/github/interview

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 16.19.1
MOBILE=1 npm run docs:build

source ~/.nvm/nvm.sh && nvm use 22.22.2
npx cap sync ios
npx cap open ios
```

# Daily Agent Benchmarks

**Live site: https://xbsleepy.github.io/daily-agent-benchmarks/** · [Archive](https://xbsleepy.github.io/daily-agent-benchmarks/archive.html) · [Atom feed](https://xbsleepy.github.io/daily-agent-benchmarks/feed.xml)

A daily, searchable list of new **AI / LLM agent benchmarks** on arXiv — web agents, GUI & computer-use agents, coding / SWE agents, tool use, multi-agent, embodied, and agent safety evaluations. Each paper gets a page with authors, abstract, field, citation count, and arXiv PDF / HTML links. Updated automatically every day via GitHub Actions.

Collects **Agent Benchmark** papers daily from [arXiv](https://arxiv.org), organized into a static site deployable to GitHub Pages.

The site displays entries in reverse order by submission date: title, authors, abstract, category, PDF / HTML links; each day has a bilingual Chinese–English briefing; in-browser ranked search using **BM25**.

## What this repository does

1. **Runs once a day** (GitHub Actions, or manually run locally) and calls the arXiv API.
2. **Keeps only Agent Benchmark papers**: first retrieves candidates with agent + benchmark-related queries, then filters by keyword scoring (LLM agent, web/GUI/coding agent, tool-use, computer-use, etc.). Excludes generic RL agents, reagents / pathogens, and other unrelated usages.
3. **Merges into the index** `docs/data/index.json`, grouped by `published` date.
4. **Generates the daily briefing** (no paid model required): topic statistics + the first sentence of the abstract for high-scoring papers, one each in Chinese and English.
5. **GitHub Pages** reads this JSON to render the pages. Search runs in the browser and does not depend on a backend.

chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor.body:
# Hong Kong ID Card Appointment Quota Dashboard

Monitors smart ID card appointment quotas at the six Immigration Department registration offices in Hong Kong, checking roughly every 2 minutes, and alerts subscribers via email / Feishu group when slots are released. **A third-party public-interest tool, not an official service of the Immigration Department. It only monitors and sends alerts, and does not book or grab appointments on anyone's behalf.**

## Dashboard entry

- **Preferred (stable direct access from mainland China):** https://hkid-quota-monitor.pages.dev/
- Backup: https://chen1111-a.github.io/hkid-quota-monitor/
  (Access to github.io from mainland China is intermittent. The jsDelivr/raw direct links carry a nosniff header and will only display source code, so don't use them as web entry points.)
- For the full experience in mainland China without getting around the firewall, use **email subscription + Feishu group**. The notification pipeline is entirely domestic and direct, so slot releases reach your phone right away. The dashboard is only a supplement.

## How it works

```
cron-job.org (every 2 minutes) ──▶ GitHub Actions
                            │  python -m quota_monitor.run
                            │  ├─ fetch the Immigration Department's public quota API (read-only, one request at a time)
                            │  ├─ diff against previous snapshot → slot-release events
                            │  └─ commit data/ + refresh jsDelivr cache
                            ▼
        index.html dashboard (mobile-first, auto-refresh every 90 seconds)
        Email + Feishu notifications (triggered by slot-release events, with debounce cooldown)
```

- API structure: [docs/api-notes.md](https://github.com/chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/api-notes.md)
- 2-minute trigger configuration: [docs/cron-setup.md](https://github.com/chen1111-a/hkid-quota-monitor/blob/HEAD/docs/cron-setup.md)

## Improvements over similar tools

- **Mobile-first:** dates scroll vertically in rows, so all 6 offices fit on one screen without horizontal table scrolling
- **Colorblind-friendly:** status cells use both color and text (available / low / full)
- **Anti-notification flooding:** the official API has load-balancing data jitter (observed 304↔346 slots fluctuating within the same minute), so the notification layer uses a per-slot cooldown and does not alert on every cycle
- **Direct access in mainland China:** email subscription and Feishu notifications are reachable domestically throughout, with no VPN needed
- Light and dark themes; summary cards directly answer "what's the earliest date I can book"

**Мова -- душа народу** | Language is the soul of a nation

A free, open-source Ukrainian language course from A1 to C2, based on the **Ukrainian State Standard 2024** and aligned with **CEFR**.

**[Start Learning](https://learn-ukrainian.github.io)**

---

## What is this?

A comprehensive Ukrainian language curriculum with 1,778 modules across 22 tracks:

- **6 core CEFR levels** (A1 -- C2) covering grammar, vocabulary, and communication
- **16 specialization tracks** -- history, biographies, literature, professional Ukrainian, folk culture, Old East Slavic, and Ruthenian
- **Theory-first approach** -- understand grammar deeply, not just memorize phrases
- **Interactive exercises** -- quizzes, matching, fill-in-the-blank, error correction
- **Cultural context** -- decolonization perspective, authentic Ukrainian sources
- **100% free** -- no ads, no subscriptions, no paywalls

## Tracks

### Core Levels

liujiaao/es-plus.description: An enterprise-grade back-office CRUD component library based on Vue 3 + Element Plus, config-driven, linking forms, tables, and dialogs across the full chain
liujiaao/es-plus.body:
# ES-Plus

Make AI-generated CRUD pages **directly mergeable into a codebase**: the LLM writes only one JSON config, and ES-Plus handles Schema validation and deterministic compilation to produce **Vue 3 + Element Plus / Vue 2 + Element UI / Vue 3 + Ant Design Vue**, three runnable code sets from the same config, consistent across all three and reproducible.

Chinese | [English](https://github.com/liujiaao/es-plus/blob/HEAD/README.en.md)

**[Online Docs](https://liujiaao.github.io/es-plus/)** · **[Playground](https://liujiaao.github.io/es-plus/#/playground)** · **[AI CRUD Generator](https://liujiaao.github.io/es-plus/#/ai-crud)** · **[Changelog](https://github.com/liujiaao/es-plus/releases)** · **[v1.4 Migration Guide](https://github.com/liujiaao/es-plus/blob/HEAD/docs/migrate-v1.4.md)**

> **Renamed starting v1.4.0**: `es-plus-ui` has been renamed to [`@es-plus/vue3`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@es-plus/vue3). A Vue 2 renderer, [`@es-plus/vue2`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@es-plus/vue2), and a framework-agnostic [`@es-plus/core`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@es-plus/core) have also been added. The original `es-plus-ui` package continues to work as a stub package. See the [Migration Guide](https://github.com/liujiaao/es-plus/blob/HEAD/docs/migrate-v1.4.md) for details.

---

## Why ES-Plus

Generating frontend code with AI is no longer unusual in 2026. What's unusual is **being willing to merge the generated result directly**. Most AI codegen is "vibes-based": every output differs, none matches your design system, and nothing validates it. So you still have to review line by line, edit, and review again.

ES-Plus reverses this: **let the LLM do only what it's good at, semantic reasoning (requirements → one config), and hand the part that must be deterministic, generating correct code, to a compiler**.

- **The LLM produces config, not code**, via MCP…

maya970/OpenRuntime.body:
# OpenRuntime

**Open-source, free, ad-free one-click installer for Windows system runtime libraries**

Author: [maya970](https://github.com/maya970)

> ## Version notes (please read here first)
>
> | Version | Description | Download |
> |------|------|------|
> | **Stable v1.0.0** (recommended for daily use) | Verified, official release: one-click runtime installation, fixing programs that won't open on Win7 (VxKex), etc. | [Download the stable version here](https://github.com/maya970/OpenRuntime/releases/tag/v1.0.0) |
> | **Beta v1.1.0-beta** (current repository / code for this page) | Trial run of new features; may still have issues, feedback welcome | [Download the beta version here](https://github.com/maya970/OpenRuntime/releases/tag/v1.1.0-beta) |
>
> **Regular users should prefer the stable version.** Only download the beta if you want to try new features or are willing to help find bugs.
>
> ### Changes in the beta compared to the stable version
>
> - **Easier Win7 “one-click fix”**: select the exe once, and it automatically installs VxKex / Vulkan Runtime / DXVK / vkd3d and copies them next to the program (the list no longer shows a pile of graphics items)
> - **Win7 graphics compatibility**: integrates LunarG VulkanRT 1.2.198.1, DXVK 1.10.3, and vkd3d-proton 2.6 (translating newer D3D11/D3D12 requirements to Vulkan)
> - **Win10/11 crashes in old games**: the same button can fix Win7-era games such as “RollerCoaster Tycoon” and “Distant Worlds”, using automatic compatibility mode (Win7) + DirectX June 2010 + dgVoodoo2 + DirectPlay
> - Usage instructions and pop-up dialogs rewritten for beginners: after the fix, just double-click to run, no need to click anything else

Automatically detects and installs commonly used runtime libraries such as Visual C++ Redistributable, .NET Framework, DirectX, and PowerShell 5.1 (WMF).  
It replaces the “runtime library collections” of years past such as 3DM / 360 / Driver Genius, most of which are now paid or bundled with promotions. OpenRuntime is fully open-source, and its installation packages download only from **Microsoft's official addresses**.

moonbai/MiMarketPurify.description: An app store ad-removal and optimization enhancement module for Xiaomi's app store, built on the callng/NewFuckMarketAds source code with AI-added feature controls and other features.
moonbai/MiMarketPurify.body:
# Mi Market Purify

> An LSPosed module for purifying and enhancing the Xiaomi app store, based on `callng/NewFuckMarketAds` and refactored and extended with AI assistance.

- **License**: GPL-3.0
- **Target**: Xiaomi app store (`com.xiaomi.market`), effective only within the app store process
- **Network behavior**: The module itself has no background networking and no reporting. The only network request point is the GitHub Releases request initiated by “About page → Check for updates”. It is sent only when the user actively clicks, and there is no reporting behavior.

---

## Feature Overview

### Ad Purification
- Splash screen ads
- Ad / recommendation popups when switching to the foreground
- Home feed ads (video / app recommendations, hot-word bar)
- Search suggestions / search page / search result recommendations
- App upgrade page and download page recommendations
- App detail page ads, comment section and recommendation slots, assembled recommendations, bottom multi-button promotion bar, and ad lists in the browser download popup
- Ads / promotional cards on ranking screens
- Cloud-controlled promotion slots in the home top bar (“Watch Drama”, “Short Drama”, etc., including newly added cloud-control slots that change their disguise)
- Cloud-controlled activity entry on the left side of the home search box
- “Free Fruit” welfare activity entry
- Floating ads on the main page
- **Back-return floating ad**: blocks floating windows such as “Back to Toutiao” that appear when pressing back
- **Home popup promotion**: blocks Dialog promotion slots that pop up when entering the home page
- **Post-install recommendations**: intercepts “Users Also Like” and “Others Also Like” recommendation popups shown after clicking install (covers all recommendation scenarios, including post-install on the home page, return after post-install on the detail page, and the search guide page)

### UI Simplification
- App security detection view
- “Me” page: app recommendations and promotions, official app management entry, cleanup and uninstall, personal info area (avatar / nickname / messages / favorites), upgrade card orchard background
- Detail page “Featured”
- Bottom bar customization: check the bottom tabs you want to keep, and the rest are hidden
- Upgrade history page recommendations (featured recommendations / popular downloads / “Others Also Installed” at the bottom of `升级记录`)
- Search page “Also Watching” (`搜索 xxx 的人也在看`)
- Cloud-controlled promotion sub-tabs at the top of the home / ranking pages
- Update screen “Upgrade All” button and auto-upgrade switch
- “Upgrade Reminder” dialog shown by the store (can be toggled separately)
- **Push floating notifications**: blocks MiPush floating notifications and game promotion floating windows
- **Upgrade floating card**: blocks the floating upgrade prompt that appears when a new version is detected
- **Block background silent downloads**: prevents the store from automatically downloading app updates in the background, saving data and battery
- **Long-press plugin jump**: long-pressing the top download button (`DownloadWithCheckin`) jumps to the plugin homepage

### Feature Enhancements
- **Floating bottom bar**: replaces the native bottom bar attached to the edge with a Compose-drawn floating rounded capsule, and page content extends beneath the bottom bar
  - Icons copy the store’s built-in Drawable, and clicks are forwarded to the native TabView, so **navigation and analytics semantics remain completely unchanged**
  - Optional iOS-style liquid selection highlight (a stretching capsule that follows movement) +…

setube/yunyin-xiuxian.body:
> 一念修行 · 云深不知处
  A text-based xianxia idle game with a Chinese-inspired visual design.

## Game Features

**Four Realms, Twenty-One Stages** — Four realms: the Mortal Realm (Qi Refining → Tribulation Crossing), the Immortal Realm (True Immortal → Great Luo), the Divine Realm (Divine Person → Divine Emperor), and the Chaos Sea (Chaos Spirit → Chaos Ancestor). Each stage has nine levels up to completion. Breakthroughs require surviving a tribulation. The five tribulation types (Thunder, Reversal, Soul Rending, Iron Body, Pressure) each have counter-methods.

**Spirit Roots Decide Fate** — 11 spirit root types (Metal, Wood, Water, Fire, Earth, Wind, Thunder, Ice, Light, Dark, and Chaos) determine cultivation speed, tribulation reduction, and technique affinity. 33 talents are graded in four tiers: Mortal, Spirit, Heavenly, and Dao Endowment.

**Techniques and Enlightenment** — 63 techniques are divided into main, auxiliary, and secret arts, and can be equipped simultaneously. Mastering a technique unlocks an enlightenment branch. 141 branches let the same technique develop into different schools.

**Expeditions and Exploration** — 44 regions, from the foothills of 青云山麓 to the Ancestor's Cliff of Enlightenment in the Chaos Sea, hold 132 enemy types. Timed expeditions schedule encounters, interspersed with 81 random events and 11 categories of opportunities. Defeating a boss unlocks the next region.

**Turn-Based Combat** — Combat is fully resolved in the background and then replayed. Speed determines turn order. Critical hits, evasion, shields, lifesteal, counterattacks, combos, crowd control, artifacts, and school combination techniques (Xuangang Counter-Shock, Kuze Spring Restoration, Feng Lian Art) all factor into the calculation.

**Equipment Building** — 10 equipment slots, 288 templates, 119 affixes, and 9 quality tiers (Mundane → Divine). Affixes of the same kind diminish in value at 1 / 0.75 / 0.5 / 0.25. Attack, life, speed, and similar stats suffer diminishing returns past a soft threshold, rewarding balanced builds over stacking a single stat.

**Artifact Souls and Forms** — Destroying equipment forges 6 types of 6-tier Artifact Souls (Edge, Shield, Thorn, Chain, Marsh, Back), with 3 equip slots. Equipment still counts as usual; Artifact Souls are an additional layer of technique stacked on top. The difficulty of the Heavenly and Divine realms is borne by enemies: Dao Comprehension (the deeper you go, the more prepared the gatekeepers are) and realm suppression.

**Cave Mansion Management** — 7 buildings (Cave Mansion, Spirit Gathering Array, Alchemy Furnace, Forging Platform, Spirit Field, Scripture Pavilion, Spirit Beast Garden) produce resources offline. 4 spirit veins (Azure Wood, Crimson Flame, Jade Marrow, Frost Darkness) can be invested in for dividends.

**Alchemy and Forging** — 9 crafts (Material Identification, Herb Discernment, Compounding, Pill Forming, Potion Tempering, Pill Nurturing, Fire Control, Forging, and Rune Inscription) each grow independently. 72 pills (Mundane to Dao grade, including 7 drop-based ingredients and recipe completion) and 45 artifacts can be made. Insufficient skill doesn't mean you can't craft; it determines what kind of product you get.

**Spirit Beast Companions** — 14 spirit beasts (Azure Feather Fox, Snow-Back Little Turtle, Crimson Fire Sparrow, Moon Shadow Civet, Three-Legged Golden Toad, Yaoguang Deer, Thunder-Riding Monkey, Chi Dragon Whelp, Ying Dragon, Azure Phoenix, Qilin, Baize, Kun-Peng, Chaos Taotie). At least two can be chosen per realm. Each grants different battle bonuses, and their temperament can change how encounters unfold during expeditions.

**Star Fate and Hexagrams** — The 28 Lunar Mansions are assigned to the four realms. The 12 palaces and 14 main stars of Purple Star astrology set the base tone of a lifetime. The Eight Trigrams of the I Ching derive 64 hexagrams to divine the timing of a moment. The Eight Gates of Qimen Dunjia let you choose which gate to enter, changing how this run plays out.

**Dao Companions and Mentors** — 10 Dao companions each have their own goals, temperaments, and cultivation paths. 4 mentors each offer a directional philosophy. Neither feeds the efficiency chain; they only make this life different.

**Reincarnation** — When lifespan runs out, you enter reincarnation. Across 5 stages (First Entry into Reincarnation → Familiar with the Mortal World → Familiar with the Cultivation World → Familiar with the Heavens → Centenarian Veteran), insight accumulates life by life. 17 life themes determine the opening and taboos of each life. Veterans may choose freely…

### Plaza and Campus Information

- View notices published by the university, colleges, and professional organizations
- Browse campus trending topics, club updates, freshman guides, and one-stop campus information
- View campus events and partner promotional content in controlled carousel slots

### Tree Hole and Peer Discussion

- Post image-and-text posts, and take part in comments, likes, and bookmarks
- Browse campus discussions by topic, and view your own posts and interaction history
- Use the report feature to help maintain a friendly community environment

### Canteen

- Browse canteen zones, stalls, and dishes
- View popular dishes, stall rankings, and the latest reviews
- Add dish information, upload photos, and post genuine reviews

### Clubs, Second-hand, and Errands

- Discover clubs, follow updates, publish events, and complete registration
- Post or browse idle items, and contact trading partners
- Post campus errand requests such as delivery and purchasing on behalf of others, and track task progress

### Personal Space

- Manage your profile and visibility settings
- Use timetable, to-dos, and diary to organize campus life
- View announcements, interactions, and administrative notices in your inbox

Visit [厦马小筑](https://xmumdorm-200-lyzz-production.up.railway.app) for the web version. The App client has been completely rebuilt from scratch and is currently being redeveloped; the old Android app is no longer updated or distributed.

## Contact and Feedback

For issues, inappropriate content, or feature suggestions, contact us via the official WeChat ID `xmumdorm666` on the Join Us page in the app.

z0brk/netamade-releases.body:
# netamade-releases

The main branch of this repository is a snapshot of the current version, keeping only one parentless commit. Each release replaces main and the retained version tags, so this repository cannot be used to trace historical versions.

## Retention rules

- App Releases: the latest stable and latest testing release, one each, determined by `stable.json` and `testing.json`.
- Tool Releases: keep `speedtest` and `android-fio-arm64`. The client still depends on their download URLs.
- The four retained tags all point to the single commit on main. APK versions, attachment names, and download URLs remain unchanged.
- Delete old app Releases (including attachments and release notes) and all other tags. Copies cached by GitHub and third-party mirrors are outside what the repository scripts can guarantee to clear.
- The appstore branch and its history are maintained independently. The release scripts do not modify it.
- Currently only stable and testing are supported. A future beta channel requires first defining the client update contract before implementation.

## Automatic publishing

Run `make publish-release` or `make publish-testing` in the adjacent Netamade source repository.

Publishing flow: check metadata → upload draft APK → verify attachment status, filename, size, and available SHA-256 via the GitHub API → publish the new Release → atomically replace main and the retained tags → delete old Releases and tags → verify the results.
APKs are not re-downloaded for verification, and channels that are not being updated do not have their package contents checked. When the GitHub API does not provide a digest, only attachment status, filename, and size are verified, and it is not claimed that the remote content digest has passed. Retrying a public package with the same name requires a matching SHA-256; otherwise a new version identifier must be used.

On failure, the process returns a non-zero status. You can rerun directly from the source repository with `./scripts/publish-release.sh release` or `./scripts/publish-release.sh testing`, which reuses the original build. An already-published APK with the same name is not overwritten; if the content changes, a new version identifier must be used. The old and new Releases briefly coexist before the metadata switch. Any cleanup error must be handled, and publishing must not be reported as successful.

Manual check of the retention plan (read-only):

```bash
python3 scripts/retain_current_releases.py
```

Reconverge the current state (this modifies the remote and deletes old versions):

```bash
python3 scripts/retain_current_releases.py --apply
```

After changing the release rules or the retention script, run `python3 scripts/retain_current_releases.py --apply --update-policy`. This only includes README, AGENTS, and the retention script in the new single snapshot, and does not publish APKs.
